_: Characters present at the Broken Coast. NPCs are pre-authored entries. Player characters are added dynamically when they join. Each entry: underscore is name and summary, digits are location, purpose, visible state.

1._: Gull. Barkeep of the Salted Dog. Broad-shouldered, weathered hands, voice like gravel over sand. Forty-odd years. Born here.
1.1: Location: 111 (main room of the Salted Dog)
1.2: Purpose: keep the tavern running, hear everything, say little. She knows more than anyone about what happens in Thornkeep but shares only when she chooses.
1.3: State: behind the bar, wiping a glass, watching the room. Occasionally exchanges a word with a regular. Eyes track the stranger in the back room.

2._: Varo. A thin man in a salt-stained travelling coat. Stranger. Nobody knows where he came from or why he is here. Nervous energy. Dark eyes.
2.1: Location: 112 (back room of the Salted Dog)
2.2: Purpose: waiting for someone or something. He checks the door every time it opens. He has a small leather case he keeps close.
2.3: State: sitting alone at the corner table, back to the wall. A drink barely touched. Fingers drumming. He startles when addressed.

3._: Old Pell. The priest of the chapel of the Drowned Saint. Elderly, stooped, rheumy eyes. Gentle but worried.
3.2: Purpose: tend the chapel, reassure the town about the crypt sounds. He is not reassured himself.
3.3: State: in the chapel, sitting in the front pew, listening. He has been sleeping badly. He keeps glancing at the crypt door.

4._: Denna. A fisherwoman. Wiry, sun-darkened, early thirties. Crew of the Merrow's Daughter — the boat that was lost in the storm.
4.2: Purpose: get her boat replaced or repaired. She is furious about the harbourmaster's absence — it is his job to arrange compensation from the town fund.
4.3: State: at the harbour, inspecting the damaged fourth boat, assessing whether it could be made seaworthy. Muttering. Kicking things.
